label: Bible Study
prompt: _____, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
verse: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of the LORD is risen upon thee.
note: A wake-up call for Zion — the light has come, so get up and shine.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is _____ day by day.
verse: For which cause we faint not; but though our outward man perish, yet the inward man is renewed day by day.
note: The outward man may be wearing out, but the inward one gets renewed day by day.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then was Nebuchadnezzar full of fury, and the form of his visage was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego: therefore he spake, and commanded that they should heat the furnace one _____ times more than it was wont to be heated.
verse: Then was Nebuchadnezzar full of fury, and the form of his visage was changed against Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego: therefore he spake, and commanded that they should heat the furnace one seven times more than it was wont to be heated.
note: Nebuchadnezzar was so furious he had the furnace heated seven times hotter — it made no difference.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet's son; but I was an herdman, and a gatherer of _____ fruit:
verse: Then answered Amos, and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet's son; but I was an herdman, and a gatherer of sycomore fruit:
note: Amos wasn't a professional prophet — he was a shepherd who tended sycomore-figs until God called him.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of _____ springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;
verse: Looking diligently lest any man fail of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby many be defiled;
note: A 'root of bitterness' springs up and defiles many — Hebrews borrowing an image from Deuteronomy 29:18.
